plugins.name: Album Cover Downloader
plugins.author: @ka1Plugins
plugins.description: Сохраняет доступное превью обложки аудиофайла в Фото.

plugins.name: Camera Flip
plugins.author: @its240hz (original)
plugins.description: Switch the round-video camera using vertical swipes or double taps. Gesture mode and haptic feedback are configurable.

plugins.name: Chat Colors
plugins.author: @lerowc & @lerowplug (original)
plugins.description: Per-chat colors in the chat list, nine presets, custom HEX, brightness, colored-chat management and reset.

plugins.name: Clean links
plugins.author: murk-sus
plugins.description: Removes tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, si, igsh…) from links you send, so they do not reveal where you found them.

plugins.name: Delete My Messages
plugins.author: @akresik
plugins.description: Поиск и удаление своих сообщений в чате после подтверждения.

plugins.name: formatted copy
plugins.author: @meatdisk
plugins.description: Native message copying with author, optional date/time, media labels and available reply quotes.

plugins.name: Arcade Games
plugins.author: @Art_727 & @lerowplug
plugins.description: 2048, Flappy Bird and Chrome Dino through the existing native Arcade Games bridge.

plugins.name: Group Mentions
plugins.author: @Hikerys
plugins.description: Native saved username groups with whole-command expansion and a per-chat cooldown.

plugins.name: HideAttachButtons
plugins.author: @optimist_opti × @KUNSESHBOY
plugins.description: Скрывает выбранные разделы меню вложений.

plugins.name: Layout fix
plugins.author: murk-sus
plugins.description: Fixes text typed in the wrong keyboard layout: "ghbdtn" → "привет", "руддщ" → "hello". Only whole messages that clearly look mistyped are changed.

plugins.name: Mini Avatar
plugins.author: @KUNSESHBOY
plugins.description: Размер аватаров около сообщений: 18–34 точки.

plugins.name: Minimal UI
plugins.author: murk-sus
plugins.description: A calmer Telegram: hides stories, similar channels, Premium statuses, the greeting sticker and the fast-share button while enabled. Turning the plugin off brings everything back.

plugins.name: petpet
plugins.author: @limeplug
plugins.description: Native petpet GIF composition from a chat avatar or an image in Files, with preview and configurable resolution/frame delay.

plugins.name: Pill Labels
plugins.author: @Persik_dll & claude
plugins.description: Обводка и фон подписей полей профиля, шесть цветов.

plugins.name: Reactions Total
plugins.author: Daxo-Developer @Daxo_OS
plugins.description: Reaction totals in the message timestamp line, with compact counts, paid-reaction and channel filters.

plugins.name: Search+ for iOS
plugins.author: @SearchPlusss (original)
plugins.description: Multi-term search in the current chat/topic. The API 9 base app also provides author, date-range and media-type filters.

plugins.name: Service Cleaner
plugins.author: Автор: @PLOXOI_RRO
plugins.description: Удаление загруженных служебных сообщений после подтверждения.

plugins.name: Smart quotes
plugins.author: murk-sus
plugins.description: Straight quotes become «ёлочки» in Russian text and “curly” quotes otherwise; "--" becomes an em dash.

plugins.name: Auto Archive Chats
plugins.author: @nainraft
plugins.description: Архивирует неактивные чаты при запуске приложения.

plugins.name: Text shortcuts
plugins.author: murk-sus
plugins.description: Expands shortcuts in outgoing messages: :shrug: → ¯\_(ツ)_/¯, :lenny: → ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°), :tableflip: → (╯°□°)╯︵ ┻━┻, ->, <-, (c), (tm) and more.

plugins.name: Unlim Accounts
plugins.author: @rezolvePlugins
plugins.description: Raises the local client add-account limit to 999 through the existing iOS bridge.
